segments.name: Digital promotions
segments.description: Sources digital promotions from clients, mainly CPG brands, and distributes them to consumers through publishers and its own properties.
segments.evidence: Our CODM, the Chief Executive Officer, manages the Company's operations as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients, primarily CPG brands, pay per redemption of their digital promotions distributed to consumers across the network.
revenueModel.evidence: We use that information to invoice our clients for the total value of those redemptions, along with our agreed upon fee-per-redemption commission.
